text: Lost session (observed mid-review: /api/me 401) is not handled: the app stays rendered as if live, every action toasts 'You are not signed in. Refresh...', the failed bubble shows the raw server string 'zaloguj sie albo podaj token' (widok-czat.js:704 uses m.error unmapped), SSE dies silently. Slack returns to sign-in and keeps the draft. Fix: on 401 from api()/SSE -> keep drafts, render login.
